change: Rebuilt both bubbles as true ellipses (rear 26x24, front 22x18) that intersect exactly at integer points (32,21) and (20,30); rear outline ends there as declared T-junctions; both tails are pointed triangles in the reference directions.
visual_review: Compared with the original; checked 48px light and dark previews: both ovals smooth, occlusion clear, tails read.
